ideas.pitch: An AI-powered computer vision and sensor analytics platform deployed around campus cafeterias and administrative blocks at BVIMR to predict peak congestion times and dynamically route students.
ideas.title: BVIMR Campus Crowd & Queue Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem the judges feel themselves daily on campus, matching the pattern of solving problems felt directly by organizers and students.

ideas.pitch: A localized financial document anomaly detection tool using graph intelligence to catch invoice tampering and circular trading patterns common among local MSMEs.
ideas.title: Delhi NCR SME Invoice Fraud Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering through graph analysis, mirroring winning techniques that successfully process complex datasets in short hackathon windows.

ideas.pitch: An optimized scheduling app that coordinates student volunteers and nearby senior citizens in Delhi NCR for essential errand runs and medical visits, addressing urban isolation.
ideas.title: LocalConnect Delhi Elder Mobility Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers clear measurable social impact with quantified metrics like hours saved and trips completed, directly aligning with successful civic tech hackathon patterns.

ideas.pitch: A specialized meal planner and nutritional intake analyzer tailored to the specific food items available in and around Bharati Vidyapeeth Institute of Management & Research canteens.
ideas.title: Campus Canteen Smart Nutrition Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on a proven fast-delivery wellness template, making it highly feasible to complete within the 24-48 hour window while remaining hyper-localized to the venue.

ideas.pitch: An automated real-time project matching and mentor allocation dashboard built specifically for HackTheStack participants to streamline team formation and Q&A queues.
